summary: Evotec SE furnished a Form 6-K with its Interim Statement for the first nine months of 2026 and accompanying corporate news, reporting group revenue down 13.1% to EUR 465.0m and adjusted EBITDA of negative EUR 44.3m, while reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance of EUR 570-610m revenue and negative EUR 70-105m adjusted EBITDA. The release also notes the CSO transition from Dr. Cord Dohrmann to Dr. Joanna Holbrook, a scheduled succession rather than an abrupt forced departure. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure, not a special situation, with no transaction terms or deal mechanics to arbitrage.
